title: The ground-truth workbook's stale, self-contradictory cached values make it fail its own verifier, so no output can pass
evidence:
Same issue reported 2 times, differing only in the verifier/range/step cited:
- I ran verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells (the only verifier, weight 1) on an unmodified copy of gt_01_golden.xlsx as the output. It returned score 0.0: 'FAILED - regression 0.9924, modification 1.0000. 65 cell error(s): Regression error at Ex 1 - LBO!C11: answer=18.2034, output=14.2033949536391; ... C32: answer=109.5182, output=101.3452; ... F21: answer=8987.8160827776, output=8101.8239139136 ...'. The verifier always recalculates the output in LibreOffice (force_recalculation=True). It then compares the result with the cached values stored in the GT and input files. Those cached values come from 
- Cached values (data_only) in gt_01_golden.xlsx, 'Ex 1 - LBO': F22 Total Sources '=+SUM(F18:F21)' is cached as 11,510.77. Its components are F18 3,209.6 + F19 0 + F20 215.42 + F21 8,987.82 = 12,412.84, which equals F28 Total Uses (12,412.84). So the GT says sources do not equal uses. Also: AC17 '=U23' is cached as 1,375.96 while U23 is cached as 1,707.50, and C11 '=+C20' is cached as 18.2034 while C20 is cached as 14.2034. These cached values are the answers the verifier grades F22, U23, C11 and the other regression cells against, and they cannot all be right at once. This is what makes the GT
confirmation: Running the verifier on an unmodified GT copy gives 65 errors (C11 18.2034 vs 14.2034, C32 109.5182 vs 101.3452, F21 8987.82 vs 8101.82) and score 0, so no output can pass.
fix: Same GT/reference recalculation; golden self-check now passes.

title: Ground truth workbook gt_01_golden.xlsx contains corrupted LibreOffice data-table cache values and fails its own verifier
evidence: In `gt_01_golden.xlsx`, the only intentional formula fixes compared to `untouched_input_Double Counting_input.xlsx` are removing double-counted cash in `Ex 1 - LBO!X20:AC20` (`=P91..U91` changed to `=+P65+P76+P85..+U65+U76+U85`) and removing cumulative prior-year double counting in `Ex 5 - M&A!D42:G42`, `D52:G52`, `D62:G62`, and `D72:G72` (`=+SUM(D36:D41)+C42` changed to `=+SUM(D36:D41)`, etc.). However, both the input and golden workbooks were saved after a destructive LibreOffice Multiple Operations pass that left 65 formula cells with stale cached values contradicting their own formulas (e.g., `Ex 1 - LBO!C32` has formula `=+C30*(1+C31)` with `C30=81.73, C31=0.24`, which equals `101.3452`, but caches `109.5182` from the table's `0.34` substitution; `Ex 1 - LBO!C11` has formula `=+C20` where `C20=14.203395`, but caches `18.2034`; `Ex 1 - LBO!U41` and `U43` cache `0.137` and `0.264` instead of `0.092` and `0.221507`; `Ex 1 - LBO!X23:AC26` cache `8987.816` while `Y24:AC24` cache `8101.824`). In addition, all 100 interior cells of the four what-if data tables (`Ex 1 - LBO!AG18:AK22`, `AG27:AK31`, `AG36:AK40`, `AG45:AK49`) cache the single base-case string `'2.4x/19%'` in `gt_01_golden.xlsx` (and `'2.4x/20%'` in the input) instead of scenario-specific values. Because `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` (weight: 1) force-recalculates `output_path` in LibreOffice (with data tables frozen) while reading `gt_path` without recalculation, evaluating `gt_01_golden.xlsx` against itself fails with `score=0` (`regression 0.9924, modification 1.0000`, 65 cell errors, below `REGRESSION_PASS_RATIO = 0.998`). Finally, 14 of the 16 fixed cells in `Ex 5 - M&A` (`D42:G42`, `D52:G52`, `D62:E62`, `D72:G72`) evaluate to `0` in both input and golden because `Ex 5 - M&A!C4` is hardcoded to `3` (selecting Case 3 where acquisitions are zero), so `mode: values` never grades those 14 formula fixes.
confirmation: Confirmed that the GT holds self-contradictory cached values from a LibreOffice multiple-operations pass and fails its own verifier (my replay: regression 0.9924, modification 1.0, 65 errors). Its data-table grid AG18:AK22 is a flat '2.4x/19%'.
fix: Same: GT recalculated so its caches match its formulas (F22 sources = F28 uses), flat '2.4x/19%' data-table interiors no longer graded. The Ex 5 fixes still evaluate to 0 under Case 3, which is the benchmark's design and was not changed.

title: Stale golden-workbook values cause the golden solution itself to fail grading
evidence: The verifier recalculates the submitted workbook but compares it against unrecalculated golden caches. Those caches contradict their own inputs: on 'Ex 1 - LBO', C32 contains '=+C30*(1+C31)' with C30=81.73 and C31=0.24, which equals 101.3452, but the golden cache expects 109.5182. Cached total sources F22=11510.772151908 also disagree with cached total uses F28=12412.840791578. Recalculating the golden workbook through the verifier's own recalculation helper and scoring it produces 65 regression errors, regression=0.9924 and modification=1.0000. Because regression must reach 0.998, the golden solution fails the sole weight-1 check and receives zero credit.
confirmation: Confirmed by local replay: the golden workbook recalculated through the verifier helper scores regression 0.9924 and modification 1.0, with C32 expected 109.5182 but recalculating to 101.3452, so it fails the 0.998 regression bar.
fix: Same GT/reference recalculation; golden replay passes.

title: The sensitivity table in the GT is flat, so 100 graded cells all hold the same string
evidence: 'Ex 1 - LBO'!AG18:AK49 are TABLE() data-table cells ('=TABLE($AF$17,$C$31,$AF18,$C$20,AG$17)') that should vary exit multiple against premium. In the GT every cell is cached as '2.4x/19%', and in the input every cell is '2.4x/20%'. That makes 100 of the 108 'modification' cells, all copies of AF17. A non-varying sensitivity grid is itself a modeling defect. It also inflates the modification set with cells that depend only on how the recalculation engine handles data tables, not on the agent's reasoning.
confirmation: Every 'Ex 1 - LBO' TABLE() cell in AG18:AK49 is cached '2.4x/19%' in the GT and '2.4x/20%' in the input, i.e. a copy of AF17. Since the verifier freezes data-table caches, these 100 modification cells test the save engine rather than the fix, and a correct openpyxl or XML edit fails them.
fix: verifications[0].parameters.answer_position: 'Ex 1 - LBO'!B1:AK95 split into B1:AF95, AG1:AK17, AG23:AK26, AG32:AK35, AG41:AK44, AG50:AK95 so the 100 TABLE() cells (AG18:AK22, AG27:AK31, AG36:AK40, AG45:AK49) are not compared; the AF17/AF26/AF35/AF44 corner labels that move with the fix stay graded.

title: Golden gate: the ground-truth deliverable does not score full reward
evidence: The ground-truth deliverable, staged at the verifiers' own output paths and graded by the problem's real grader, scored 0.00 (need >= 1.00). A correct answer that does not earn full reward means a verifier false-negatives the mandated work. With the ground truth staged, every one of the 1 checks on /home/model/Desktop/output.xlsx scored 0 (summed weight 1.000), which is the whole shortfall of the GT grade. A correct deliverable does not fail every check at once; the ground truth for this file most likely never reached the grader (paired with a file of another type or name), so these are not 1 separate verifier defects. Checks: SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check.
confirmation: Local replay of gt_01_golden.xlsx through the verifier's recalc and score_workbooks gives regression 0.9924 (below 0.998) with 65 errors such as 'Ex 1 - LBO'!C11 18.2034 vs 14.2034, so the golden deliverable scores 0.
fix: ground_truth/gt_01_golden.xlsx and untouched_input_Double Counting_input.xlsx: cached <v> of the 65 stale formula cells (Ex 1 34, Ex 2 3, Ex 5 28, e.g. 'Ex 1 - LBO'!C11 18.2034 -> 14.2034, C32 109.5182 -> 101.3452) replaced with the values from the verifier's own managed_recalculated_xlsx; no formula, style or other cell changed. answer_position now skips the TABLE() grids. Local replay: golden PASS (reg 1.0, mod 1.0).

title: SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check: verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells trivially fails (score 0.0) on all runs and on the golden workbook itself due to asymmetric LibreOffice recalculation
evidence: `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` (weight: 1) calls `managed_recalculated_xlsx(Path(output_path), force_recalculation=True, model_deliverable=True)` on the agent's output, which strips data-table `<f>` elements via `freeze_datatable_formulas` and runs LibreOffice with `OOXMLRecalcMode=0` to force-recalculate all remaining formulas, but loads `reference_path` (`untouched_input_Double Counting_input.xlsx`) and `gt_path` (`gt_01_golden.xlsx`) raw without recalculation. Because `gt_01_golden.xlsx` contains 65 stale cached values from a prior LibreOffice Multiple Operations pass (`Ex 1 - LBO!C11: answer=18.2034, output=14.2033949536391; Ex 1 - LBO!C32: answer=109.5182, output=101.3452; Ex 1 - LBO!C34: answer=11968.0393778, output=11074.9021108; Ex 1 - LBO!C37: answer=12289.9413778, output=11396.8041108; Ex 1 - LBO!F20: answer=215.4247088004, output=199.3482379944`, etc.), every unit's recalculated output fails on those exact same cells (Unit 1: `score=0`, regression 0.9623, modification 0.0000; Unit 2: `score=0`, regression 0.9882, modification 0.0556; Unit 3: `score=0`, regression 0.9888, modification 0.0741). Even Units 2 and 3, which found and fixed the exact ground-truth double-counting bugs in `Ex 1 - LBO!X20:AC20` and `Ex 5 - M&A!D42:G42, D52:G52, D62:G62, D72:G72`, could only reach `modification 0.0556` (6/108) and `0.0741` (8/108) because `freeze_datatable_formulas` froze the 100 `TABLE(...)` modification cells in `Ex 1 - LBO!AG18:AK49` at their input cached string `'2.4x/20%'` instead of updating them to `'2.4x/19%'`.
confirmation: Reproduced: the GT's stale caches (e.g. C32 cached 109.5182 though =C30*(1+C31) gives 101.3452, F28 12412.84 vs recalculated 11510.77) fail against any recalculated output. All three trials of run <id> scored 0 with those same regression errors.
fix: Same recalculated GT/reference (no stale caches such as C11 18.2034 or C32 109.5182 left) plus the data-table cells removed from answer_position; an openpyxl output with only the 22 GT formula fixes now scores PASS, the untouched input scores mod 0.0.
